question: Is an ACCOUNT node's node_id the account id on every path that can build or serve a holdings answer the page receives?

denominator.basis: One entry per producer function, consumer module, declared-key file, fixture or page path. Enumerated with Glob over infra/aws/lambda/investor-reporting/holdings, data/assets/scripts/gold/investor_reporting and portal/src/pages/InvestorReporting, and with line-anchored Grep for node_kind, ACCOUNT, opaque, mint and node_id over infra/, data/assets/ and portal/src/ (non-test, non-fixture), plus contracts/fixtures and holdings/tests. Every entry was read by Read or by a line-anchored Grep/sed of the cited lines. Not counted: data/assets investor_reporting unit tests; portal smoke and fixture JSON (fixtures, not producers); four holdings tests that matched the ACCOUNT grep but were not read as producer paths (test_aggregates.py, test_ruling22_refusals.py, test_entry_guarded.py, test_publication_entry.py).

unequal_paths: data/assets/scripts/gold/investor_reporting/holdings_49f.py:339 (live 49F; keyed on the Schwab dim_balance key, not the directory key)
infra/aws/lambda/investor-reporting/_contracts/fixtures/HoldingsSnapshot.valid.json:41 (contract fixture; node N-1 vs ref A-0001)
verdict_basis: ids_equal_on_all is false. Two enumerated paths do not build the ACCOUNT node id as the account id by rule: the live 49F builder mints from a different key space than the directory (row 1 against rows 9-10; directory_runner.py:37-56 names the two spaces), and the valid contract fixture models node N-1 against ref A-0001 (row 22). The 49F defect is fail-closed at serve (snapshot.py:442-443) and at resolve (resolve.py:512): an unequal account is refused or withheld, never served under a wrong id. INF is equal by rule (rows 2, 5, 6, 11); COT is declared-equal (rows 3, 8, 12).
page_map_blocker: The step-3 map needs an account id per ACCOUNT node that the page can read. None exists on the wire: adapt.ts:1219 reads drill_refs[0].ref_id, and every producer sets that ref_id to the node's own minted id (holdings_49f.py:349; holdings_inf.py:357; holdings_snapshot.py:1377, 1448, 1542, 1658, 1749, 2464). The directory account id (adapt.ts:680) is paired to no node. A map built in tabs/holdings/ would have no source. The producer would need to carry the directory account id, and that file sits outside this grant (infra/ and data/assets/ are read-only here). Blocking row: DSGN_IRPTV1-D2-W72-S1.
not_run: No portal edit was made, so no lint, typecheck, suite or mutant run was taken. The order's rule was: run the whole-scope suite only if the page changes.
